rules.signature: Real signature with the portfolio links from profile.json.

variables.job: company, title, location, lane, lane_title, pathway_tag, pathway_type, pathway_detail, noc, apply_url, posted, tier, gap_flags, fit_sentence, years_line
variables.profile: name, known_as, city, province, portfolio.*, credentials

templates.name: Direct application follow-up
templates.purpose: Sent after an application is submitted. Names the role, the date, one traceable reason he fits, resume attached.
templates.subject: {{title}} application, {{known_as}} {{last_name}}

templates.name: Second touch after a follow-up
templates.purpose: One short nudge a week after the follow-up. Never sent to a pattern_guess address.
templates.subject: Re: {{title}} application, {{known_as}} {{last_name}}

templates.name: Cold approach, no posting
templates.purpose: For designated AIP and RCIP employers where no live posting matches but the pathway does. Leads with the value to the employer. This is the only template allowed to mention an immigration pathway, and only as an employer benefit.
templates.subject: {{lane_title}} candidate for {{company}}

templates.name: Referral or informational
templates.purpose: Shorter. Asks for a conversation rather than a role.
templates.subject: {{lane_title}} question, {{company}}
